subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: After a large construction contract is fully signed and insurance certificates are cleared, the agency issues a document officially authorizing the contractor to mobilize, site-prep, and establishing the exact start date for the project timeline. This document is known as a:
questions.explain: A Notice to Proceed (NTP) is a formal notification issued by the agency to the contractor establishing the specific date the contractor may enter the site and begin work, triggering the countdown for the contract completion time.
